decisions.summary: Split ocean volume across at least two carriers on every busy lane after the 2023 Pacific Arc Shipping strike

messages.author: EMP-N-004
messages.text: Pacific Arc Shipping crews walk out tomorrow. Every lane they run is affected, Busan is the worst.

messages.author: EMP-N-005
messages.text: Moving the Standard Class orders to the same lanes on other carriers. Mostly one extra day.

messages.author: EMP-N-004
messages.text: Decision: from now on no busy lane depends on a single carrier. Split volume across at least two.
